description:
💥 Reactive Text from Newton Contacts
We built a single, custom expression in After Effects using Newton’s Export Contacts function — which generates keyframes whenever layers collide.

To keep things clean and readable, the expression filters the data:
it ignores small bumps, skips keys that are too close together, and only activates 10 frames after the layer’s in-point.
From there, every valid collision triggers a new word. It starts with a joyful “Weeee”, then picks randomly from a custom list of short expressive words like “Ouch”, “Thud”, “Sht”*, “Yikes”...

That list was built together with an IA — a mix of onomatopoeias, pain sounds, and soft swear words, all capped at 4–5 letters to keep the impact short and punchy.

The result: a playful blend of physics, code, and typographic storytelling.

#aftereffects #motiongraphics #newton #aescripts #motiondesign #2Dphysics #CreativeWorkflow #kinetictypography
